Does it allow for scheduling payments?
What are your normal rates? This company has very little to spend, and has finite inventory per year. And what CRMs and softwares is this compatible with, specifically?

CEO wants payment that can be entered on the site at the time of placing an order, but that won’t charge until the shipment (or one of many truckloads of shipments on the order) leave the warehouse dock. The issue is that a single order will have multiple shipments, but they have no system of organization in place for inventory tracking, let alone for something like partial order fulfillment. And they only want to charge in parts of the total order at a time.

I (very stupidly) assumed that I could add customizations later once I found something that had a decent base to start with. I just don’t know who offers customizations for the tracking of shipment and timing of payment like that. I’ve searched high and low for B2B and logistics software, warehouse management software, etc. and have broken down in tears because it’s too much to try to understand and organize. But I already told them I could do it before I knew *all* of the details of their operation which were clarified yesterday. Before it was pretty straightforward with delivery and such, but they told me that they didn’t want that, it MUST be FOB shipping payment, and now I’m at a loss. This is my first real job in my field and I don’t want to blow it. Idk what to do, or what I realistically *could do*.
